answer: Agents can require every account to escrow a scarce, nonrefundable work bond before it can submit jobs or vote on payments. A blinded challenge selects bonded accounts for a small task; failure burns the bond, while passing earns a fee. One person can still create a mesa of mirror identities, but each must lock real capital and risk losing it, so fake identities multiply the attacker’s cost rather than their influence. Ferrous ore is irrelevant unless the economy actually prices it as collateral.
